response.sql: WITH patient_figures AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) - AVG(l.TP) AS alb_minus_tp, AVG(l.APTT - l.PT) AS aptt_minus_pt FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_figures AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(alb_minus_tp) AS alb_minus_tp, AVG(aptt_minus_pt) AS aptt_minus_pt FROM patient_figures GROUP BY SEX), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(aptt_minus_pt) AS mean_aptt_minus_pt FROM sex_figures) SELECT AVG(s.alb_minus_tp) AS avg_alb_minus_tp, AVG(s.aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt, AVG(s.aptt_minus_pt - b.mean_aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_excess_aptt_minus_pt FROM sex_figures AS s CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE s.aptt_minus_pt > b.mean_aptt_minus_pt;
